files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
CalDAV write support for JournalNotes.

- Added write support for VJOURNAL resources
- Journal entries can now be created from CalDAV clients
- Existing Journal entries can be updated from CalDAV clients
- Tested write support with DAVx5 and JTX Board
- New VJOURNAL resources are stored as JournalNotes entries
- When an entry already exists for the same date, newly created VJOURNAL
  content is appended to the existing Journal entry
- When appending a new VJOURNAL, its SUMMARY is added as a Markdown
  bold heading before the DESCRIPTION
- PUT on an existing canonical VJOURNAL updates the corresponding
  JournalNotes entry
- Deleting Journal entries through CalDAV remains intentionally disabled
- JournalNotes remains the canonical storage and source of Journal data
- Companion VEVENT resources remain available for calendar clients
